name: com.lettance/rules
title: Lettance
description: Cited rental intelligence for England. Free coverage and preflight. Prepaid data and assessments.

tools.name: check_address
tools.description: Costs 1 prepaid credit. Look up dated council and scheme facts for an English postcode. Returns scheme type, status, dates, sources, and research gaps. Use preflight_property and assess_property for a property-specific licensing decision.

postcode.description: Full postcode of the rented property, not the user's own location, e.g. SE15 5BA

household.description: single: one household; small_hmo: 3-4 people from 2+ households; large_hmo: 5+ people from 2+ households

requestId.description: Purchase UUID. Reuse only for a retry with identical arguments.

tools.name: search_rules
tools.description: Costs 1 prepaid credit. Use for general questions about what private landlords in England must do, such as gas safety, deposits, EPC ratings, smoke alarms or notices. Searches Lettance's catalogue of rules, each cited to legislation.gov.uk or GOV.UK, and returns matching rule ids with summaries. Use get_rule for one rule's full detail. Read-only.

query.description: Keywords, e.g. 'gas safety certificate' or 'deposit protection'

requestId.description: Purchase UUID. Reuse only for a retry with identical arguments.

tools.name: get_rule
tools.description: Costs 1 prepaid credit. Use when you have a rule id from search_rules and need its full detail: the requirement, deadline, evidence to keep, penalty, legal basis and official guidance links. Read-only. Unknown ids return an error rather than a guess.

requestId.description: Purchase UUID. Reuse only for a retry with identical arguments.

tools.name: council_licensing
tools.description: Costs 1 prepaid credit. Find an English council by name or slug. Returns sourced scheme types, status, dates, area classification and application links. Check the linked council notice for full terms and fees.

council.description: Council slug or name, e.g. 'southwark' or 'Tower Hamlets'

requestId.description: Purchase UUID. Reuse only for a retry with identical arguments.

tools.name: plan_rental
tools.description: Costs 1 prepaid credit. Build a dated rental checklist from the postcode and facts supplied. Licensing tasks link to council sources for property-specific checks.

postcode.description: Full postcode of the rented property, not the landlord's own, e.g. SW9 7AA

household.description: single: one household; small_hmo: 3-4 people from 2+ households; large_hmo: 5+ people from 2+ households. Defaults to single.

letting.description: now: tenants live there; next: a tenancy is starting, or the home is being got ready to let

tenancy_start.description: The current tenancy's start (letting now) or the next tenancy's planned start (letting next), as YYYY-MM-DD

has_gas.description: Whether the home has any gas appliance, such as a boiler, hob or gas fire

last_gas_check.description: The date of the last gas safety check, from the gas safety record, as YYYY-MM-DD

last_electrical_inspection.description: The inspection date on the last electrical installation condition report (EICR), as YYYY-MM-DD

next_electrical_inspection.description: The next inspection date the last EICR sets, which can be sooner than 5 years, as YYYY-MM-DD

epc_rating.description: The EPC's current energy rating, A to G

epc_expiry.description: The date the EPC expires, as YYYY-MM-DD

holds_licence.description: Whether the landlord holds the kind of council licence the address needs for this household (the plan's licence question names it); only matters where one is needed

licence_end.description: The date the council licence ends, as YYYY-MM-DD

deposit_taken.description: Whether a tenancy deposit was (or will be) taken

deposit_received.description: The date the deposit was received, often before the tenancy starts, as YYYY-MM-DD

deposit_protected_in_time.description: Whether the deposit was protected and the prescribed information given within 30 days of receiving it

right_to_rent_checked.description: Whether every adult's right to rent was checked before the tenancy was agreed

tenancy_document_given.description: Tenancies from before 1 May 2026: whether the government information sheet (or written terms, for an oral tenancy) was given by 31 May 2026. Later tenancies: whether the written statement of terms was given before the tenancy was agreed. late: given, but after that

alarms_tested_at_start.description: Whether the smoke and carbon monoxide alarms were tested on the day the tenancy started

last_rent_increase.description: The date the last rent increase took effect, if there was one during this tenancy, as YYYY-MM-DD

rent_period.description: How often the rent is due

furnished.description: Whether the landlord supplies any furniture

requestId.description: Purchase UUID. Reuse only for a retry with identical arguments.

tools.name: compare_addresses
tools.description: Costs 1 prepaid credit. Compare two to four postcodes for English council and market data. One credit if any property resolves. If none resolves, no charge: no_data_available for permanent misses or upstream_unavailable if a lookup needs retrying.

postcodes.description: Full postcodes of the rented properties, at most 16 characters each, e.g. ["SE15 5BA", "SW6 1HS"]

household.description: single: one household; small_hmo: 3-4 people from 2+ households; large_hmo: 5+ people from 2+ households

requestId.description: Purchase UUID. Reuse only for a retry with identical arguments.

tools.name: area_market
tools.description: Costs 1 prepaid credit. Use when someone asks about typical rents or house prices around a postcode in England. Returns the ONS average monthly private rent for the local authority (with bedroom breakdown and annual change) and the HM Land Registry median sale price and number of sales for the postcode district, from a dated snapshot. Each figure carries its source, release and obtained dates, period and the required attribution. Read-only. Area figures only, never a valuation of one home. Information, not financial advice.

postcode.description: Full postcode in England, at most 16 characters, e.g. SE15 5BA

requestId.description: Purchase UUID. Reuse only for a retry with identical arguments.

tools.name: data_coverage
tools.description: Free. Use when someone needs to know which English councils, assessments, rules, forms, wards or market periods Lettance covers. Returns published and held councils, research and verification dates, review scope, source links and gaps. Read-only.

tools.name: council_reviews
tools.description: Free. Use when someone asks when an English council’s rental licensing evidence was checked, which official sources changed, or where coverage is incomplete. Read-only. With a council slug, returns source links, comparison dates and independent field decisions. Omit the slug for national coverage and a paged council list. A publisher change is a research lead.

council.description: Exact council slug, for example hammersmith-and-fulham. Omit for national coverage.

limit.description: Up to 10 councils nationally or 10 distinct citations for a named council.

edition.description: Pin this to the edition on the first page when following nextOffset.

tools.name: preflight_property
tools.description: Free. Check the available licensing assessment scope, missing facts, and quoted credit cost for an English rental.

household.description: Private rent, as occupants’ main home. Single is one household; two_sharers is two people from different households; small_hmo is 3–4 people from two or more households; large_hmo is 5+ from two or more households.

ward.description: Ward confirmed for this exact address on the council's own checker. Omit when unknown.

tools.name: property_history
tools.description: Retrieve retained licensing, fee, issued-licence and planning evidence for 1–25 distinct English UPRNs. Supply since to compare dated positions. A batch of evidence costs one credit. Including letting facts buys a single local assessment for ten credits. Unsupported dates and missing portfolio baselines are explicit.

uprn.description: Exact Unique Property Reference Number, as a string.

applicationDate.description: Date of the application for the fee schedule. Defaults to the observation date.

leedsAccreditedOwner.description: Proposed licence holder is both the property owner and a Leeds Rental Standard member at application.

leedsTransferredSchedule.description: An application originally lodged before 26 February 2026 was transferred to the revised Leeds fee split.

licenceExpiryDate.description: Expiry of the existing licence being renewed. Portsmouth uses this date to select the renewal tariff.

occupants.description: Number of occupants for the York HMO tariff.

yorkQualifiedHolder.description: The licence holder qualifies for York's recognised HMO training or qualification discount.

standardTariffConfirmed.description: Applicant has confirmed the ordinary rate applies with no discounts, surcharges, late treatment or special categories.

brentAccreditedHolder.description: Holder qualifies for Brent's London Landlord Accreditation Scheme discount.

islingtonAccreditedHolder.description: Holder qualifies for Islington's accreditation discount.

islingtonEpcDiscount.description: Property has a valid EPC rating of A, B or C at application.

islingtonRenewalDiscount.description: Qualifying Islington renewal for the same premises with no gap.

mode.description: Use the evidence retained on each date, or reconstruct the effective position using later acquired dated source evidence.

knownOn.description: Latest evidence acquisition date allowed in reconstructed mode. Defaults to today.

asOf.description: End-of-day observation in UTC. Defaults to today.

since.description: Compare the retained position on this UTC date with asOf.

requestId.description: Purchase UUID. Reuse only for a retry with identical arguments.

tools.name: register_reference
tools.description: Costs 1 prepaid credit. Look up an exact published licence or planning reference in a named source, including registers without UPRNs. A reference match alone does not identify a property. No charge when no record matches.

requestId.description: Purchase UUID. Reuse only for a retry with identical arguments.

tools.name: application_outcome_benchmark
tools.description: Costs 1 prepaid credit. Get partner-reported median council licensing decision time and total fee for the latest publishable quarter. Includes the sample size and its limitations. No charge if the cohort is insufficient.

councilGss.description: Current English council GSS code, for example E08000035.

requestId.description: Purchase UUID. Reuse only for a retry with identical arguments.

tools.name: assess_property
tools.description: Costs 10 prepaid credits. Purchase the cited, dated licensing assessment for one property and its household. Run preflight_property first.

household.description: Private rent, as occupants’ main home. Single is one household; two_sharers is two people from different households; small_hmo is 3–4 people from two or more households; large_hmo is 5+ from two or more households.

ward.description: Ward confirmed for this exact address on the council's own checker. Omit when unknown.

acceptNationalOnly.description: Set true only when the user accepts national-only coverage.

requestId.description: Purchase UUID. Reuse only for a retry with identical arguments.
